mechanism_narrative: A lower unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a tight labor market that supports corporate earnings growth and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when UNRATE is below 4.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 3.0% signals an active monetary tightening cycle that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 3.0% (or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates an overheating economy with aggressive monetary tightening, which typically triggers market corrections and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (FEDFUNDS rising and UNRATE falling) fails to predict negative returns in more than 40% of cases (or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 6.0% year-over-year), the Federal Reserve maintains restrictive monetary policy, which compresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of high inflation periods (CPIAUCSL > 6.0%) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts (HOUST) level below 1500.0 thousand units indicates weak consumer demand for housing, which often precedes broader economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST is below 1500.0 (or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 (index) signals reduced manufacturing output and supply chain disruptions, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO is below 100.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a weak retail sales regime (RSAFS < 650000 million), consumer spending is insufficient to drive corporate revenue growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of weak retail sales periods (RSAFS < 650000) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a broad-based economic slowdown, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (HOUST and INDPRO both declining) fails to predict negative returns in more than 40% of cases (or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window).
